messages:
Nina Park: Kicking off quota intake for ap-southeast1 cluster bootstrap. We need 48x A100-equivalent GPUs for a 10-day validation window, then drop to 24 for steady traffic. Requesting temporary reservation, not commit.

Leo Huang: Agreed on temp first. Can we justify spot/interruptible for validation? Might save 30-50% but risk instability for perf tests.

Carmen Ruiz: For the soak we need deterministic latency so prefer on-demand or reserved short window. Spot OK for non-critical workers.

Tom Blake: Checklist to include in cloud support ticket:
- GPU SKU and machine family
- total GPUs (48 -> 24)
- vCPU quota and regional IPs
- PD throughput and disk quotas
- exact start/end timestamps for reservation
- contact emails and approver
- brief test plan link

Nina Park: Adding network egress and Cloud NAT IP count. Our boot scripts spawn ~150 ephemeral nodes for sharding, so ephemeral IPs and forwarding rules matter.

Leo Huang: Include sample commands so support can reproduce quickly:
```
# list quotas for region
gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --project=redwood-prod | jq '.quotas'
# show GPU quota metric
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-prod | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUs")'
```

Carmen Ruiz: Fallback plan: if GCP quota denied, request equivalent on AWS in ap-southeast-2 (p4d/g5dn), pre-push images to that registry and flip DNS for canary.

Tom Blake: Rollback: reduce to 10% traffic, scale down nodes, reroute jobs to existing dedicated pool in us-west1, and open incident channel #incidents.

Finance-Lead: Please add cost ceiling and approver. Finance can provisionally approve up to $9k/day for the soak; need daily burn tracked.

Nina Park: Thanks. I'll include a short cost table in the ticket and mark MJ as approver. Also requesting non-exclusive reservation (no placement guarantees) but capacity hold for the window.

infra-bot: Created ticket QRT-8391: https://tickets.redwood.ai/QRT-8391

CloudSupportBot: If you include start/end ISO timestamps and an engineering contact, we can often fast-track within 24-48h.

Leo Huang: Preflight before reservation goes live:
- quota ticket approved
- billing contact validated
- images replicated to fallback
- smoke run passed in staging
- infra-oncall assigned for window

Carmen Ruiz: Note from past run: we were blocked by vCPU quota mismatch. Request vCPU numbers that match expected instance counts.

Nina Park: Good catch. I'll add exact vCPU and PD throughput numbers. Planning to submit ticket today; will post updates here when support responds.
